description:
Chickpea or lentil gene from the Legume Information System (these genomes are not in Ensembl Plants), or a gene
of the extra faba bean and lentil gene sets: location, functional description, LIS legume gene family, curated
lentil symbols and gene lists (flowering, pigment, resistance gene analogues), best protein match to the reference
gene set, and link. gene: a gene ID (e.g. 'Ca1g000100', 'Lcu.2RBY.1g000010', 'Vfaba.Hedin2.R2.1g000001'), a
curated lentil symbol (e.g. 'LcFIE'), an Ensembl faba bean v1 ID (lists its v2/Tiffany counterparts) or words from
the description (e.g. 'flowering locus T'). Datasets: 'chickpea' = Cicer arietinum CDC Frontier (kabuli) assembly v3 (gene IDs like Ca1g000100, chromosomes chr1-chr8); 'chickpea_kabuli_v1' = the original kabuli CDC Frontier genes (Ca_00001 IDs used in most chickpea papers) placed on the UWA kabuli v2.6.3 assembly (Ca1-Ca8); 'chickpea_desi' = desi ICC 4958 genes (also Ca_ IDs, but different genes from the kabuli Ca_ IDs) on the UWA desi v3.0 assembly (Ca1-Ca8); 'lentil' = Lens culinaris CDC Redberry assembly v2 (IDs like Lcu.2RBY.1g000010, chromosomes Chr1-Chr7); extra gene sets (no LIS families; best protein match given): 'faba_v2' = faba bean Hedin/2 v2 (Vfaba.Hedin2.R2.1g000001, chr1_partA/B, chr2-chr6; matched to Ensembl Hedin/2 v1), 'faba_tiffany' = faba bean Tiffany (Vfaba.Tiffany.R1..., matched to Ensembl v1), 'lentil_greenstar' = lentil CDC Greenstar (Lcu.1GRN.1g000010) and 'lentil_ervoides' = Lens ervoides IG 72815 (Ler.1DRT.1g000010), both matched to LIS CDC Redberry v2. Gene families (LIS legume.fam3) also cover pea (Cameor, Psat... = Ensembl Plants pisum_sativum IDs), soybean (Wm82.a2, Glyma.01G000600 = Ensembl GLYMA_01G000600) and Medicago truncatula (A17 v5, MtrunA17Chr...).
